author: scotty_d96
quote: Jst don't get the hype around GTA VI. It's the same old formula with a weak story. Plunging a virtual girlfriend's sink, putting away her groceries, and picking out her outfits doesn't scream FUN. Graphics are decent for such a large map, map is cool, but that's about it for me. Maybe GTA Online won't be a disappointment.

author: scotty_d96
quote: Coming back to Nintendo after 25 years on PlayStation and PC, this remake is Incredible. Great story, awesome graphics, and modern tweaks. Now I'm wanting to play through all of the Zelda's.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
